newsitem.title: POLAND: AIB in talks on extending WBK stake.
newsitem.headline: AIB in talks on extending WBK stake.

text.p: The Allied Irish Bank Plc (AIB) is in talks with Polish and Irish authorities about its plan to extend equity in Poland's Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK) to a majority stake within three years, an AIB spokesman said.

On Tuesday the Polish Securities Commission said it had no objections against AIB subsidiary AIB European Investment Ltd raising its stake in WBK from the current 36.3 percent by buying a 23.9 percent stake presently owned by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD). @
"AIB is in discussions with authorities about clearing regualory obstacles to aquire additional WBK shares," a spokesman for AIB in Dublin told Reuters.

AIB said it held an option to buy the EBRD's shares, within a three year period from Januray 31, 1997, at a price calculuted by a formula, which now estimated the effective price of the option at 12.7 zlotys per share.
On Wednesday WBK traded at 28 zlotys per share.
